capabilities: Display a monthly calendar with lunar dates, festivals, solar terms, and workday/off-day markers
Mark notes on the calendar by creation or modification date
Create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes with per-type titles and paths
Apply Templater templates when creating the five note types
Filter which vault folders are scanned for notes to show on the calendar
extras: README is mainly in Chinese with English manifest; it lists unimplemented features (week/year views, task integration, mobile support, i18n) and depends on the lunar.js library for lunar-calendar data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view that maps notes to dates or shows Chinese lunar dates, holidays, and solar terms.

relations.evidence: 本插件可选集成 Templater 插件：创建日记/周记/月记/季记/年记时自动套用模板

summary: Calendar sidebar that shows lunar dates, holidays, workday adjustments and solar terms, links notes by date, and creates daily-to-yearly notes.
